description: Return top SwitchWize rates with freshness and attribution. Savings, CDs, checking and money market answer only from their editor-approved snapshot. A category with no approved release yet returns no ranked rates and says so (approval_status: not_yet_approved) rather than serving unverified observations; approvedOnly makes that requirement explicit. Approved responses include product terms and field evidence; stale or unavailable releases return no ranked rates. detail=full (savings) adds the complete shared build: every listed account marked verified or tracked, best picks, movers, history and a headline summary.

approvedOnly.description: Require an editor-approved deposit snapshot. Savings, CDs, checking and money market always answer from their own approved release; a category with no release yet returns no ranked rates (approval_status: not_yet_approved), as do stale or unavailable releases.

category.description: U.S. deposit category: savings (alias hysa), cds, money-market (alias mma), or checking.

detail.description: summary (default) adds list_counts. full (savings) adds the complete shared build: accounts (verified and tracked, each marked), best_picks, movers, history and summary. rates stays verified-only either way.

name: get_top_rates
title: Top Rates
